definition: אַכְזָב adjective deceptive, disappointing (elative; opposed to אֵיתָן q. v. below יתן ) — only absolute singular: — Mic 1:14 (with play on proper name אַכְזִיב ); of a deceptive, disappointing stream (compare Isa 58:11 ) Jer 15:18 (|| מַיִם לֹא נֶאְמָ֑נוּ ; on meaning compare Job 6:15 ff.)
